name: copy_name_until_colon
description: Copies characters from a source string into a fixed buffer until it reaches a NUL byte or a colon, then terminates the buffer. It also makes several calls and a loop that repeats while a returned high word is zero, which suggests device or volume name handling.

name: handle_vertical_blank_interrupt
description: Runs when the interrupt master enable and the relevant request bits are set: it steps a BCD tick counter, calls a stored callback, and wraps the counter at a limit. It then acknowledges the interrupt by writing the vertical blank bit to the interrupt request register.

name: spin_if_count_positive
description: Tests whether the low word of the data register minus one is non-negative; if so it enters an infinite loop with no exit, otherwise it returns at once. It reads as an unreachable or failure trap, with no other effects.

name: chain_calls_forwarding_registers
description: Calls one unnamed routine with no arguments, then calls a second unnamed routine passing on the caller's data and address register values unchanged. It is a thin pass-through wrapper that returns nothing.

name: dispatch_by_mode_bits
description: Selects among several unnamed routine calls according to bits of its flags argument: bit 0 makes one call and repeats it on a negative result, while bits 1 and 2 select other calls. If no mode bit is set, it returns a fixed sentinel value.

name: call_follow_up_if_positive
description: Calls one unnamed routine and, if the value it returns is greater than zero, calls a second routine. Otherwise it returns without further action.

name: call_routine_if_positive
description: Calls one unnamed routine and, when the value it returns is greater than zero, calls another routine. It behaves identically to its neighbour that does the same check, differing only in its return type.

name: take_matching_table_entry
description: Scans a fixed table of 14-byte records for an entry whose key matches and whose count is at least the requested amount, choosing the smallest or largest match by a flag. It removes a fully used entry by shifting the table, reduces the count of a partly used one, and writes a new record into a second table; it returns the matched count, or -1 when nothing matches.

name: move_entry_to_free_slot
description: Finds a positive-count entry with the given key in one record table and moves it into the first free slot of a second table, clearing the original. It then shifts records to compact the second table and merges adjacent free spans, returning zero, or -1 when no entry or free slot exists.

name: sum_table_record_sizes
description: Walks the fixed record table while each record's size field is positive, accumulating the sizes with clamping on overflow and doubling the total at the end. A type field of two selects a branch that performs the same accumulation.

name: push_sentinel_then_call
description: Steps a pointer back by one word, writes the all-ones sentinel into it, calls one unnamed routine, and then advances the pointer past the new entry. It appears to push a word-sized marker onto a small handle stack.

name: initialise_record_tables
description: Clears two fixed tables of 29 entries each, setting every key and count to sentinel values. It then seeds the first table's first entry, and a second entry when the seed counter is nonzero, with values derived from that counter.

name: reset_fixed_slot_pointer
description: Writes the all-ones sentinel into a fixed longword cell and points the shared pointer at that cell. It is a single-purpose reset of an unused location.

name: call_process_function_by_index
description: Validates a function index in the range one to ten, maps it to a table entry, and runs the matching callback through a stored pointer after a checked call sequence. Out-of-range or uninitialised requests wait on a button-state bit before returning an error; the referenced text lists general, invalid-process and no-memory error messages for this path.

name: activate_entry_if_inactive
description: Returns zero at once when the indexed entry's status word is already set. Otherwise it resets the entry, makes a sequence of calls, then marks the entry active and stores a value into it, returning zero on success or minus one with the status cleared on failure.

name: fetch_record_with_fallback
description: Calls one routine and, when its result is not positive, tries a second source and then a third fallback. It clears two status fields of the chosen record and returns that record's two longword fields as a packed pair.

name: find_first_free_record
description: Walks a table of 30-byte records from a fixed start address, advancing while each record's first word is non-negative. It stops at the first negative marker and leaves the pointer there with no return value.

name: dispatch_indexed_handler
description: Splits a longword argument: a zero high word is passed to an error reporter with code 1005, a high word of 999 or more indexes a jump table of handler routines, and other values report the same error. Each error path waits on a hardware busy flag before returning.

name: handle_load_procedure_result
description: Processes the result of a load-procedure call: a zero high word runs a follow-up read and stores the loaded pointer and size into the caller's record, while a valid index dispatches through a jump table. Failure paths report error messages and wait on the busy flag; the referenced text covers reading, closing and right-button abort.

name: lookup_table_value_by_index
description: Calls one unnamed routine to obtain an index; when the index is nonzero and in range after clearing its low bit, it returns the table value stored at that position. Otherwise it returns the raw index unchanged.

name: clear_fixed_120_byte_buffer
description: Zeroes a fixed 120-byte buffer one byte at a time, then calls one unnamed routine. It resets the shared counter to zero beforehand.

name: parse_packed_segment_list
description: Reads a stream of run headers that ends with a four-byte marker. For each entry it writes a five-word record holding the header byte, the running offset, and a length taken from a 30-bit field, advancing the offset by that length, and terminates the output with a sentinel word.

name: call_after_noop_assignments
description: Repeats three self-assignments of a shared variable, which have no effect, and then calls one unnamed routine. The self-assignments look like leftover stubs in the decompiled code.

name: accumulate_segment_lengths_into_records
description: Reads the same kind of byte-coded run list and, for each entry, adds the running shared value into a ten-byte record's total field while storing the entry's length in a second field. It returns when the four-byte end marker is reached.

name: release_registered_entry_by_key
description: Releases a registered entry identified by a key argument: a negative key is matched by its magnitude in an index table and cleared, while a positive key is found in the active table, unloaded through a library call when flagged, and reset. Unload failures report an error and wait on the busy flag before returning.

name: copy_name_after_status_check
description: Makes a routine call and, only if it returns zero, copies a name from a source string into a fixed buffer until a NUL byte or a colon. It then calls a routine repeatedly until its returned high word is nonzero, and it is the same copying logic as the earlier name-copy routine.

name: copy_name_and_poll_value
description: Copies a name from a source string into a fixed buffer until a NUL byte or a colon, then repeatedly calls a routine until its returned high word is nonzero. It is the unconditional variant of the name-copy routine, with no initial status check.

name: call_library_offset_minus_30
description: Calls an Amiga library function at offset minus thirty when the shared flag is zero, after saving two register values into shared cells. Otherwise it runs one unnamed routine instead.

name: call_library_offset_minus_42
description: Calls an Amiga library function at offset minus forty-two when the shared flag is zero. Otherwise it runs one unnamed routine instead.

name: call_library_offset_minus_36
description: Calls an Amiga library function at offset minus thirty-six when the shared flag is zero and returns its result. Otherwise it runs two unnamed routines and returns the value of the first.

name: load_module_or_report_error
description: Pushes a sentinel word onto a small stack, calls a loader routine, and on success stores a flag and calls a follow-up routine before returning zero. On failure it waits on the busy flag, clears its state and returns minus one; the referenced text is the module loading error message.

name: store_minus_one_if_clear
description: When the shared flag is zero, it stores minus one into the flag and calls one unnamed routine. It always returns zero.

name: stop_audio_dma_channels
description: Clears a shared variable and calls the routine that switches off the four audio channels by clearing the audio DMA enable bits, then returns zero.

name: service_audio_channel_registers
description: Waits on the video beam position between steps and, when the shared flag is clear, writes four saved values into the audio channel registers. It then advances a shared tick counter and a ramp value, repeating until the ramp reaches its limit.

name: tick_shared_channel_effect
description: Advances the effect state of the currently selected channel using a packed command word held in shared memory. Commands cover arpeggio, slides, volume changes and speed settings, and the resulting period is written to the audio period register.

name: trigger_channel_note_cell
description: Reads a four-byte note cell for a channel and, when the cell names a sample, loads that sample's volume, start address and length into the channel state. It then applies the cell's effect, including sample offset, position jump, pattern break, set volume and set speed commands, with extended commands in their own branch.

name: run_channel_effect_tick
description: Runs the per-tick part of a channel's effect using the channel structure's own effect word. It steps the period toward a target for slides and portamento, applies arpeggio by tick phase, updates volume for slide and tremolo style effects, and returns the new period.

name: copy_channel_status_word
description: Copies a 16-bit status field from one channel structure into a fixed field of another, with no return value. It is a small field-transfer step.

name: set_slide_target_from_table
description: Searches a per-sample table of ascending values for the first entry not below the channel's current value, and stores it as the channel's slide target. It sets a slide-direction flag when the target is lower and clears the target when the two values are equal.

name: step_channel_slide_toward_target
description: Moves the channel's current value by its step toward the stored target, clamping once the target is reached, and maps the result through a per-sample table. When no target is set it returns the argument unchanged.

name: apply_vibrato_offset_step
description: Looks up a waveform sample for the channel's current phase, scales it by a depth nibble, and adds the signed result to the channel's base period. It then advances the phase by a rate nibble.

name: dispatch_channel_effect_command
description: Decodes the effect nibble of a channel's note cell and applies the matching command, covering sample offset, position jump, pattern break, volume set and slide, speed, and extended subcommands. It writes the resulting value to the channel's volume and period fields and returns it.

name: store_low_nibble_field
description: Copies the low four bits of one byte from a channel structure into another field of the same structure. It has no return value.

name: format_text_into_buffer
description: Interprets a format string whose conversion specifiers cover strings and decimal values, copying the expanded text into a fixed buffer and terminating it with a NUL byte. Its arguments are read from the caller's stack frame.

name: format_text_with_stack_args
description: Expands a format string with conversion specifiers for strings and numbers into a fixed buffer, reading each argument from the caller's stack frame. It duplicates the body of its neighbouring formatter and differs only in its entry point.

name: format_hex_digits_into_buffer
description: Expands a format string into a fixed buffer using the same parser as its neighbours, with a hexadecimal digit table as the referenced text for numeric output. Arguments are taken from the caller's stack frame.

name: extract_digit_by_repeated_subtraction
description: Counts how many times a divisor fits into a value by repeated subtraction, then stores the matching character from a digit lookup table at the output address. It is a decimal digit conversion step used when formatting numbers.

name: scroll_and_draw_text_row
description: When the row counter has passed its limit, scrolls the text bitmap up by one character row and clears the bottom row. It then draws each character of the current string from an eight-row font table into the bitplane and advances the row counter.

name: scroll_and_draw_text_duplicate
description: Repeats the scroll-and-draw logic of its neighbouring routine with identical code, scrolling the text bitmap and drawing the string's glyphs from the same font table. It advances the same row counter.

name: start_copper_list_dma
description: Waits for a shared flag to reach the sentinel value, then loads the copper list address into the first copper pointer register, strobes the copper jump register, and enables bitplane DMA through the DMA control register. It returns its argument pair unchanged.

name: enable_copper_and_dma
description: Waits for a shared flag to reach the sentinel value, then loads the copper list address, strobes the copper jump register, and enables bitplane DMA through the DMA control register. It returns its argument pair unchanged; this is the copper start sequence without the preliminary register copies.

name: clear_longword_buffer
description: Zeroes a buffer of 240 longwords starting at the shared pointer, then resets that pointer to zero.

name: pass_through_routine_call
description: Calls one unnamed routine and returns its register arguments unchanged. It is a pass-through wrapper; the constant merges it contains have no effect on the result.

name: initialise_disk_controller_once
description: On its first call, sets the disk sync word and disables and clears the interrupt and DMA registers, then configures the audio-disk control bits and records the setup flag. If the setup has already run it returns a failure code of minus thirteen instead.

name: clear_state_return_status_error
description: Clears a shared state variable and returns a status code of minus twelve together with its argument. Its only effect is that state reset.

name: parse_device_path_name
description: Splits a name of the form device, colon, path into two length-prefixed fixed buffers, copying each byte through a helper routine. It returns a distinct negative status code for a wrong state, an empty name, a missing colon, or a busy state, and a non-error value on success.

name: move_block_overlap_safe
description: Moves a block of bytes between two buffers, copying forward when the destination lies before the source and backward otherwise so overlapping regions survive. It checks a shared state flag first and returns negative status codes on error.

name: stub_return_error_minus_ten
description: Returns a status code of minus ten together with its argument. It is an unreached stub decoded from non-code bytes, with no other effects.

name: start_request_by_state
description: Returns a status of minus five when the shared state is clear. Otherwise it calls one routine, resets two fields and returns one, with minus eleven as the fallback status.

name: scan_stride_until_status
description: Unreached code decoded from a gap: it steps a counter down in 244-byte strides, calls one routine per step, and returns status minus fifteen or minus sixteen depending on the result. Its behaviour is provisional because the gap decodes as code.

name: stub_conditional_call_stride
description: Unreached gap code that calls one routine when a counter has not reached a fixed stride value. It has no other effects.

name: return_status_minus_fifteen
description: Returns a status of minus fifteen together with its third argument. It is an unreached stub with no other effects.

name: return_status_minus_sixteen
description: Returns a status of minus sixteen together with its third argument. It is an unreached stub with no other effects.

name: empty_return_routine
description: Does nothing and returns. It is an empty routine called from three places.

name: search_named_entry_table
description: Scans up to seven table slots, comparing each slot's stored name with a name held in a shared buffer by calling a helper to read the characters. It returns the matching result when a name matches, minus seven when a helper reports an error, and zero when no entry matches.

name: find_entry_by_name_list
description: Walks a linked list of named entries, comparing each entry's stored name with the current name. On a match it sets the shared pointer to that entry's link field, and when nothing matches it sets the shared flag to its all-ones value.

name: hash_name_into_bucket
description: Hashes a length-prefixed name by multiplying a running value by thirteen and adding each byte, then reduces the result to a bucket index between six and seventy-seven. It stores that index in the shared variable.

name: seek_disk_block_position
description: Converts a block number below 1760 into a cylinder, head and sector position using eleven sectors per track, then steps the drive head through the difference from its current position. Out-of-range block numbers set a status value and return without seeking.

name: start_disk_motor_and_sync
description: Sets the disk sync word and the interrupt and DMA control registers, waits for the drive's index pulse through the CIA port, and selects the drive motor. It then waits for disk ready, clears the disk transfer length and returns a status value of sixteen.

name: decode_mfm_sector_from_track
description: Scans raw track data for the disk sync word, checks each sector header's checksums against the expected track and sector values, and decodes the matching 512-byte sector from its MFM encoding into the destination buffer. It tries up to forty sync words before setting a failure status.

name: compute_mfm_xor_checksum
description: XORs a run of longwords together starting from zero and returns the result masked to every other bit, the checksum used by the disk sector format.

name: no_operation_return_stub
description: Does nothing and returns. It is an empty routine, with no effect on the state.

name: clear_disk_control_bit_three
description: Sets the high bits of the shared disk port value and clears bit three of it, storing the result back in the shared variable. It is a single-bit update of the drive control value.

name: pulse_disk_select_and_step
description: Sets and clears drive-select and step bits in the shared disk port value, choosing the bits from the results of two calls. It then enters an endless loop with no return.

name: set_then_clear_disk_bit
description: Forces the upper bits of the shared disk control value, then clears the single bit selected by its low three bits. It is a drive control update.

name: wait_disk_busy_bit_clear
description: While a status bit in the shared disk value stays set, it toggles a control bit, loads two timing values and calls a delay routine. When the bit clears it zeroes the shared value.

name: wait_for_cia_flag_set
description: Busy-waits until bit zero of the shared value becomes set, which is the timer event flag read from the CIA interrupt control register.

name: select_disk_drive_pattern
description: When a status bit in the shared disk value is set, it calls a routine if another bit is clear, sets the low bits to a drive-select pattern, and calls one more routine.

name: call_then_set_disk_bits
description: Calls a routine first when bit one of the shared disk value is set, then clears the low two bits, sets bit zero and calls another routine.

name: wait_cia_timer_interval
description: Loads two timer values into the shared CIA timer state and busy-waits for the timer event flag, which marks the end of the interval.

name: wait_cia_timer_long_interval
description: Loads a different pair of timer values and waits for the timer event flag, giving a longer delay than its neighbouring timer wait.

name: pulse_disk_port_with_waits
description: Waits for the timer flag, clears one control bit, loads timer values and waits for the flag again. It is a disk port timing sequence.

name: set_disk_control_bit_timed
description: Waits for the timer flag, sets one control bit, loads timer values and waits for the flag again. It is the opposite-polarity twin of its neighbour, setting the bit where that one clears it.

name: run_disk_command_state_machine
description: Drives a disk operation through a small state machine, switching on a shared state value from zero to five and calling a stored callback at each transition. It checks shared flags and returns early when a step reports completion or an error.

name: run_disk_state_steps
description: Runs a sequence of steps selected by a shared state value from zero to eleven, calling one routine per state and invoking a stored callback in state one. It ends by setting the shared result to its all-ones value.

name: run_disk_phase_sequence
description: Loops through disk phase steps numbered one to five, calling a routine for each and invoking a stored callback in phase one, until the phase counter reaches five. It then sets the shared result to its all-ones value.

name: run_disk_steps_until_six
description: Runs the same phase loop as its neighbour but starts from phase four and stops when the counter reaches six. It then sets the shared result to its all-ones value.

name: run_disk_step_loop_states
description: Repeatedly dispatches disk states one to five through routine calls until the state reaches zero, six or seven. On reaching six or seven it sets the shared result to its all-ones value.

name: silence_audio_channel_volumes
description: Calls one routine and then zeroes four shared volume values, which are the shadow copies of the audio channel volume registers, leaving all four channels silent.

name: advance_audio_channel_index
description: Advances a shared channel index, wrapping after three, calls two routines, and reads a flag from a table for the new channel. When the flag is clear it zeroes that channel's state fields, and it returns the flag bit.

name: load_initial_state_table
description: Writes a fixed sequence of constant values into shared state cells, such as configuration bytes and counters, then returns. It makes no calls and acts as a table initializer.

name: store_pointer_table_addresses
description: Stores eleven fixed addresses into shared pointer variables, setting up the buffer and table references used by the other routines.

name: initialise_channel_state_block
description: Copies a shared value into a block of channel state bytes, sets several flags to one, loads a value from a lookup table and computes a derived pointer. It then calls two setup routines.

name: relocate_hunk_pointers
description: Adds a base address to the pointer fields of a loaded code structure, including a counted list of pointers that is fixed up in turn. It rebases addresses after the code has been loaded at a different base.

name: forward_single_routine_call
description: Calls one unnamed routine and returns, with no other effect.

name: delegate_to_single_routine
description: Calls one unnamed routine and returns; it differs from its neighbour only in its entry point.

name: store_routine_result_global
description: Calls one unnamed routine and stores its return value in the shared variable.

name: write_incremented_two_digits
description: Adds one to the low word of its argument and writes the result as two decimal ASCII digits, splitting at ten. Values of ten or more produce distinct tens and units characters.

name: initialise_shared_flag_bytes
description: Writes a shared value and fixed flag values into nine consecutive state bytes. It makes no calls and returns without a result.

name: call_stored_callback
description: Calls a callback routine held through a stored function pointer and then returns.

name: invoke_callback_pointer
description: Calls the same stored callback pointer as its neighbour, from a different call site, and returns.

name: conditionally_copy_table_or_wait
description: Calls a check routine and, when it reports a nonzero result, calls another check. It then either waits on a timer or disk flag bit and returns a value, or copies a header and a word table up to the sentinel value 1279.

name: allocate_slots_until_stable
description: Clears a 15-byte scratch array and repeatedly assigns slot counts to a list of records until no further assignment happens. It then marks the output slot as empty and returns zero when no candidate was left over, otherwise minus one.

name: call_single_routine_wrapper
description: Calls one unnamed routine and returns, with no other effect.

name: init_slot_record_fields
description: Initialises a slot record by copying a leading word, clearing two fields and storing the supplied sizes and offsets into their fields. The referenced text includes an allocation failure message and a right-mouse exit message, which belong to the caller.

name: run_program_main_entry
description: Program entry that finds its own task, opens the system libraries, parses a help switch from the command line, and sets the background colour register. Its main path handles a message port and returns zero on exit.

name: run_state_machine_locked
description: Brackets a state-driven loop with multitasking forbid and permit calls. On state three it clears a table region, fills a short table with all-ones values, and calls routines to prepare the next state, with the state values selecting which steps run.

name: call_routine_if_sentinel_state
description: Calls one unnamed routine when a shared state value equals minus one hundred and three or minus one; otherwise it returns without action.

name: open_system_library_pair
description: Opens two system libraries through the exec open-library call, stores the returned library bases in shared variables, and calls a third library function on the result.

name: enter_supervisor_mode_if_needed
description: Checks the low nibble of a processor-related field and, when it is greater than one, calls the exec supervisor function to run code in supervisor mode. It clears the shared variable afterwards.

name: save_state_start_copper
description: Saves the interrupt, DMA and disk-related custom chip registers into shared memory, waits for the blitter-busy bit to clear, and loads and strobes a new copper list address. It then enables the interrupt and DMA bits and returns zero.

name: clear_buffer_and_set_pointers
description: Zeroes a 240-longword buffer and then stores a set of table addresses into shared pointer variables, preparing the data areas for later use.

name: restore_custom_chip_state
description: Waits for a busy bit to clear, then disables all interrupts and DMA channels and clears the interrupt request bits. It restores the stored copper and interrupt vectors, calls the library close and old-open functions, and re-enables DMA and interrupts.

name: free_two_memory_blocks
description: Releases two memory blocks through the system free-memory call when each block pointer is nonzero. It has no return value.

name: allocate_two_blocks_or_fail
description: Calls the system allocation function and, when the first result is positive, makes a second allocation when a flag is set. If the second allocation fails it frees the first block, returning zero on success and minus one on failure.

name: query_available_memory_amount
description: Queries the system for available memory through the exec available-memory call and passes the result to one unnamed routine. The decompiler could not produce pseudo-code, so the behaviour is taken from the library call alone.

name: free_memory_and_clear_slot
description: Calls a stored function pointer and one unnamed routine, frees a memory block through the system free-memory call, and clears a pointer slot to zero. The sequence is a cleanup of the block and its slot, with no allocation step.

name: decode_lz_backreference_stream
description: Decompresses an LZ-style stream: it reads token bits to choose a literal or a back-reference, derives a copy length from the token, and copies bytes from an earlier position in the output. Literal bytes come from a bit reader routine.

name: select_half_or_input_word
description: Returns the input word unchanged unless the flag word equals one, in which case it returns the second word shifted right by one bit, which halves it.

name: mask_word_by_table_entry
description: Looks up a word in a fixed table indexed by the second argument and ANDs it with the first argument, returning the masked result. Each table entry acts as a bit mask.

name: read_bit_stream_longword
description: Reads the longword that precedes the current input pointer, stores its low byte into the output word, and returns it shifted right by one bit with the top bit set. The top bit serves as an end marker for the bit stream.

name: shift_bit_buffer_count
description: Shifts a bit buffer right once per count, refilling it from the input through a helper routine whenever it empties, for the number of steps given in the second argument.

name: stub_bad_instruction_data
description: Control flow reaches bad instruction data, so the decompiler reduced the routine to an empty endless loop. No behaviour can be recovered beyond the calls it attempted.

name: wait_for_signal_then_load
description: Stores the address of a shared cell in a structure field and sets a flag byte, then busy-waits until that cell becomes nonzero. It then loads a value from the cell and calls one routine three times.

name: run_helpers_then_halt
description: Calls several helper routines in sequence, including one through a stored function pointer, and then enters an endless loop with no return.

name: clear_counters_and_table_block
description: Decrements four counters with clamping at zero, sets two mode values through calls, and clears a four-row table of seven-byte cells at a fixed stride. It finishes by setting shared values to all-ones and zero.

name: clear_table_cells_block
description: Zeroes a four-row table of seven-byte cells at a fixed stride, then sets a shared value to all-ones and clears another one.

name: init_five_record_links
description: Sets two link pointers to fixed addresses, clears a shared counter, and writes a fixed word into two fields of each of five eight-byte records.

name: adjust_word_list_until_zero
description: Checks a fixed value, then walks a zero-terminated list of words, subtracting a fixed offset of 49152 from each entry and copying the next value into the following entry. It ends in an endless loop with no return.

name: halt_after_clearing_flags
description: Clears a shared value, masks it with a flag bit, sets a status byte to all-ones, calls two helper routines, then enters an endless loop.

name: select_task_entry_and_run
description: Selects an entry from a pointer table by index and initialises it if it is inactive. It copies the entry's state word into two fixed locations and runs its optional callback, then calls a second callback through a further pointer, falling back to an empty routine when none is set.

name: copy_eight_longword_blocks
description: Copies eight longwords from a table into fixed memory cells, then copies another eight-longword block into a second set of cells, and clears the shared value.

name: activate_records_overlapping_view
description: Searches a ring of 24 grid positions around the view for a free cell, then walks a list of three-byte object records ended by an all-ones byte. Each record whose bounding box overlaps the view is copied into an active slot with a data pointer chosen by its type, and the source record is then cleared.

name: reset_flags_on_code_match
description: When a shared state byte equals one of two fixed codes, it clears three flag bytes, calls a routine while waiting for those flags to change, and then clears the state byte.

name: clear_flags_on_letter_e
description: When the shared state byte equals the letter E, it clears four shared bytes. Otherwise it returns without change.

name: invert_flag_on_marker
description: When the shared state byte equals a specific marker value, it inverts a flag byte, mapping zero to all-ones, and calls one routine. Otherwise it returns.

name: stub_store_flag_byte
description: Unreached gap code that stores an all-ones byte into a flag cell when the shared state is clear, then calls one routine.

name: step_palette_colours_toward_target
description: Moves each of fifteen 12-bit colour words one step toward a target by adjusting its red, green and blue nibbles separately with borrow handling, and stores the result back into the colour table.

name: reset_object_pool_free_list
description: Returns active nodes to a pool by copying a pending byte into each one, then rebuilds a free list of thirty-nine fixed-size nodes and clears the pool's head and counter fields.

name: allocate_pool_node
description: Takes the next free node from a pool of thirty-nine entries, clears its flag and state fields, and advances the free list. It returns without action when the node index is outside the pool.

name: link_node_into_list
description: Links a node into a list headed by a fixed sentinel address, setting its tag field and incrementing the shared count. It does nothing when the node is the sentinel itself.

name: append_node_to_list_tail
description: Appends a node to the tail of a linked list, clearing its next pointer and incrementing the shared count. It ignores the sentinel node.

name: unlink_node_to_free_list
description: Unlinks a node from its doubly linked list and returns it to the head of a free list, then decrements the shared count. It was decoded from a gap, so the detail may be incomplete.

name: call_method_for_each_node
description: Walks a linked list and calls the routine stored at a fixed offset in each node, stopping at the terminating link. It does nothing for an empty list.

name: layout_sprite_entries_from_list
description: Initialises three fields of an object to fixed defaults, then walks a list of positioned entries and computes each entry's coordinates from a base offset. It finishes by clearing a field of the list head.

name: update_flagged_list_entries
description: Initialises two sentinel fields, then walks a linked list calling a routine for each entry whose flag is set, and finally clears a counter field in the list head.

name: draw_clipped_sprite_frame
description: Draws a sprite frame into the display after clipping it to the playfield bounds, computing the screen position and bitplane offset. It waits on the blitter busy flag between blits and advances the frame from the sprite record.

name: stub_update_object_position
description: Unreached gap code that adds two position deltas to an object's coordinates, subtracting a shared offset, and clears its animation and status bytes.

name: start_blitter_operation
description: When a shared flag is set, it clears the flag, programs the blitter mask and size registers with fixed values, then starts two blitter operations and waits for each to finish.

name: handle_copper_interrupt_flag
description: Checks a shared interrupt flag and, when set, clears it and runs a short chain of routines. It reads and clears the interrupt request state, acting as an interrupt service hook.

name: write_copper_sprite_words
description: When the shared value is nonzero, writes two copper instruction words into fixed locations. The low word is chosen by the parity of the value, and the next word is derived by shifting the value down one bit.

name: update_sprite_position_table
description: Calls a stored callback when one is set. Otherwise it advances an animation counter, selects one of two position tables, and writes a set of coordinate values derived from the counter, spaced by a fixed row offset.

name: update_sprite_pointer_pairs
description: Advances a countdown counter, derives a horizontal offset from it, and writes four pairs of sprite position words spaced thirty bytes apart. The base position is chosen from one bit of the counter, and the counter is set to a marker value when the update finishes.

name: fade_palette_when_timer_zero
description: When a shared counter is zero, steps each colour word of a fifteen-entry palette one unit toward its target by nibble-wise borrow arithmetic. Otherwise it only decrements the counter.

name: step_palette_nibbles_unconditional
description: Performs the nibble-wise palette step of its neighbour unconditionally, with no counter check, over the same colour table.

name: spawn_or_retire_sprite_slots
description: Initialises an object's fields, then sweeps seven sprite slots, clearing expired ones and claiming a free slot at a computed column when one is available. It calls one routine for each active slot.

name: blit_four_sprite_rows
description: Computes a base screen address from a sprite record and a counter, then issues four blitter operations at fixed row and column offsets. It waits for the blitter to be idle before each operation.

name: blit_four_sprite_rows_offset
description: Performs the same four-row blitter sequence as its neighbour, using base values passed in registers rather than computed from the sprite record.

name: blit_tile_grid_fill
description: Fills a grid of tiles by issuing a fixed blit control word in nested loops of nineteen rows, four groups and twelve cells, waiting for the blitter between operations.

name: blit_tile_grid_fill_variant
description: Repeats the tile grid fill of its neighbour from a different call site, using the same nested loops.

name: blit_tile_grid_from_base
description: Performs the same nested tile-grid blit loops as its neighbour, with the starting address taken from its argument register.

name: stub_clear_sprite_slot_flags
description: Unreached gap code that clears a block of counters and then clears seven slot records and their flag bytes, calling one routine for each active slot.

name: copy_bitplane_columns_from_source
description: Copies four interleaved byte columns from a source buffer into the four bitplanes of a screen strip, advancing eight source bytes and thirty-eight destination bytes per row for four rows.

name: copy_bitplane_strip_from_table
description: Copies six rows of four interleaved bitplane bytes from a fixed source table into the screen strip at a position given by the second argument, using the same source and destination steps as its neighbours.

name: copy_bitplane_rows_counted
description: Copies a counted number of rows of four interleaved bitplane bytes from the source buffer into the screen strip, using the same stride as its neighbours.

name: stub_copy_strip_by_counter
description: Unreached gap code that, while a counter is below five, increments it and copies six rows of bitplane bytes from a fixed table into the strip.

name: stub_advance_strip_copy
description: Unreached gap code that increments a counter and copies six rows of bitplane bytes from a fixed table into the strip.

name: copy_strip_rows_descending
description: Decrements a shared counter and, while it stays non-negative, copies six rows of bitplane bytes from a fixed table into the strip at an odd byte offset. Otherwise it clears the counter.

name: stub_copy_frame_entry
description: Unreached gap code that advances a frame counter and, on wrap, a second counter, then copies a sixteen-byte entry selected by the low nibble of a frame value into sixteen strip positions.

name: copy_frame_entry_bytes
description: Copies the sixteen-byte entry selected by the low nibble of a frame value into sixteen strip positions, after calling one routine.

name: copy_frame_entry_from_counter
description: Copies the same sixteen-byte entry as its neighbour, selected by the low nibble of a different shared counter.

name: stub_copy_nibble_pattern_rows
description: Unreached gap code that advances a counter and copies a twelve-byte pattern into a strip at six-byte stride, writing a half-intensity copy of the last column.

name: copy_pattern_column_on_step
description: When a shared counter is nonzero and a flag is zero, decrements the counter with a wrap at nine and copies a twelve-byte pattern into a strip at six-byte stride. The last column is written at half intensity.

name: copy_pattern_column
description: Copies a twelve-byte pattern selected by a shared index into a strip at six-byte stride, writing a half-intensity copy of the last column, after calling one routine.

name: tick_countdown_and_rearm
description: Decrements a shared countdown and returns while it stays non-negative. When it expires it re-arms from a fixed value, advances a second counter with a wrap at nine, and calls routines to update the display state.

name: call_routine_three_times
description: Calls one unnamed routine three times in a row and returns.

name: clear_table_cell_rows_again
description: Clears the same four-row table of seven-byte cells as its neighbour, then sets a shared value to all-ones and clears another.

name: update_channel_slot_entries
description: Updates a channel record selected by the low nibbles of shared bytes, copying a timing value and a flag into it when a counter is due. It then writes a fixed byte across five rows of a 38-byte-stride table and clears those rows when a value is below six.

name: stub_schedule_slot_update
description: Unreached gap code that subtracts an argument from a shared counter, clamps it at zero, and when a flag is clear selects a record and writes its state if it is free. Its behaviour is provisional because the gap decodes as code.

name: stub_decrement_and_schedule
description: Unreached gap code that subtracts an argument from a shared counter, clamps it at zero, and when a flag is clear updates a selected record. It returns no value.

name: set_flag_one_return
description: Sets a shared flag byte to one and returns, with no other effect.

name: clear_slot_flags_and_notify
description: Clears seven slot counters, sets each slot flag to one and resets each slot status to zero, then calls one routine for each slot whose flag is set.

name: copy_sixteen_bytes_to_strip
description: Copies a sixteen-byte entry selected by the low nibble of its argument from a fixed table into sixteen positions of a screen strip at the given destination.

name: copy_pattern_column_strided
description: Copies a twelve-byte pattern selected by the low nibble of the argument into a strip, using stride values passed in registers, and writes a half-intensity copy of the last column.

name: stub_reset_sound_state
description: Unreached gap code that clears two flag bytes, calls four routines, zeroes a set of state words and sets a counter to fifteen. Its behaviour is provisional because the gap decodes as code.

name: update_sound_pending_commands
description: Each tick, applies a pending sound command by mapping its low four bits to state values and then clears it. When a channel flag is set, it runs two update routines and copies pending table values into the channel state.

name: reset_sound_driver_state
description: Clears two flag bytes, calls four routines, zeroes a set of state words, sets a counter to fifteen and clears a final flag. It is the same reset as its unreached copy in the gap code.

name: store_sound_flag_byte
description: Stores the low byte of its argument into a shared sound flag cell and calls one routine.

name: dispatch_sound_sequence_command
description: Unreached gap code that decodes a sound sequence word: commands in the top range are handled by a switch on their low nibble, while other words set pitch, length and volume fields in the channel record.

name: initialise_sound_driver_tables
description: Sets up the sound driver by clearing a flag and a pending value, storing table addresses derived from the driver base, and clearing thirty-two channel entries. It then stores four list pointers and a set of default values into a table.

name: stub_reset_sound_state_unreached
description: Unreached gap copy of the sound state reset, which clears two flag bytes, calls four routines, zeroes state words and sets a counter to fifteen.

name: tick_channel_row_countdown
description: Decrements a channel's row countdown and, when it expires, reloads it from a shared value and steps through a fixed sequence of routine calls until the channel flag clears.

name: process_channel_sequence_bytes
description: Reads the next sequence byte for a channel from its table. Bytes below the command range set the note and advance the channel, while command bytes in the top range are dispatched by their low nibble to effect handlers that update the sequence pointers and parameters.

name: stub_advance_channel_marker
description: Unreached gap code that marks a channel's status as all-ones, advances a wrapping counter in a two-word record, calls one routine, and sets a flag to all-ones.

name: step_channel_sequence_entry
description: Alternate entry into the channel sequence processor: it decrements the channel's countdown or reloads it, then reads the next sequence byte and dispatches it as its neighbour does.
